headline: Veldin and menu code become complete as PAL v2.00 reaches 57.44%
summary: Veldin's opening level and the executable's menu unit become fully matched in #36. Ratchet & Clank's PAL v2.00 rises from 56.30% to 57.44% matched code, with 3,427 of 5,109 entries reported finished. A matched function compiles to exactly the same bytes as the original game. Further library work adds exact implementations through Sony's compiler, and the project adopts GPL-3.0 licensing.
highlights: The largest retained near miss closes, and corrected function declarations turn other existing reconstructions into matches (#36).
#40 proposes removing compiler-output repair steps and moving flags to whole files. It has not merged.
Further function contributions open as #37, #38 and #39, with no merge that day.
